headline: Engineering Manager | Technical Lead | Full-Stack & AI Product Engineer
summary: Engineering manager and hands-on full-stack engineer with 6+ years building and leading web, mobile, and AI products. Progressed from Associate Software Engineer to Software Engineer, Tech Lead, and Engineering Manager across Leapfrog Technology and Naamche/reAlpha, and now Lead Engineer at Cantordust building pharmaceutical document intelligence. Led architecture, technical planning, delivery, and team development while shipping TypeScript and Node.js services, React applications, GraphQL APIs, PostgreSQL data models, AWS infrastructure, and LLM-powered features.

roles.title: Lead Engineer
bullets: Document pipeline: Building the ingestion and processing pipeline that parses raw pharmaceutical documents into structured, queryable data models.
Architecture: Owning architecture across services, data model, retrieval layer, and the infrastructure it runs on.
Engineering foundations: Setting up repository structure, CI, deployments, and review practices for an early-stage product while scoping work with the team and domain experts.

roles.note: Naamche acquired by reAlpha, NASDAQ: AIRE
roles.title: Engineering Manager | Tech Lead | Software Engineer
roles.context: Joined Naamche as one of seven engineers and grew with the company beyond 75 people through its acquisition by reAlpha
bullets: Leadership and progression: Advanced from Software Engineer to Tech Lead and Engineering Manager, leading cross-functional delivery while remaining hands-on across backend, frontend, infrastructure, and LLM products.
Engineering standards: Established architecture, code review, QA, design, and release practices across multiple product teams, improving consistency across the delivery lifecycle.
Technical delivery: Owned system design, API contracts, CI/CD pipelines, AWS deployments, and production iteration for client and internal products.
Backend and data: Designed Node.js and TypeScript services and GraphQL APIs backed by PostgreSQL; applied caching and query tuning when justified by load.

Planning and stakeholder management: Scoped ambiguous requirements into technical plans and estimates with stakeholders across the US, Nepal, Indonesia, and Singapore; aligned engineering capacity with portfolio priorities.

AI platform: Rebuilt AiChat's conversational AI platform with prompt orchestration, grounded responses, async messaging, observability, model-cost controls, and WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram integrations.

roles.title: Software Engineer | Associate Software Engineer
bullets: Product delivery: Built and shipped web and mobile applications using REST APIs, relational data models, and frontend state management.
Software delivery: Translated product specifications into implementation plans, tasks, estimates, and production releases while progressing from Associate Software Engineer to Software Engineer.

Team development: Mentored engineers and interns on Node.js API development, service structure, code review, and testing; interviewed candidates and coordinated Leapfrog's first Data Internship cohort.

roles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
roles.context: Concurrent product building and selective freelance engagements
bullets: Client delivery: Delivered full-stack web and mobile applications for WealthTech and Upwork clients, from data modeling and API design through CI/CD and release.
Integrations: Integrated third-party services and built reliable data pipelines for inbound and outbound data exchange.
Product exploration: Built founder-led proof-of-concepts for market and technical validation, plus an internal employee operations system.
